label: compose_mqtt_gateway_restart_and_kill
setup: docker compose stack (Kafka, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, MinIO, EMQX 5.8.9), simulator publishing over MQTT QoS 1 at up to 5,000 events/s, one gateway (client id gateway-0), two normalisers
procedure: pause the simulator, wait until EMQX inflight/queue and every consumer lag are 0, read the books (A)
resume; after 45 s `docker compose restart gateway` (SIGTERM, graceful)
after 40 s `docker kill --signal KILL rosetta-gateway-1`, then `docker compose start gateway`
after 40 s pause, drain as above, read the books (B)

before_the_fix.description: gateway client id changed on every restart and the session lived 2 h: stale members of the shared group received a share of the traffic and dropped it; a graceful shutdown that ended the session made EMQX drop messages with no subscriber while the only gateway restarted
before_the_fix.measured: about 2.8% of unique events missing in the same procedure; EMQX messages.dropped.no_subscriber 15,149; a stale session with 1,441,272 dropped messages
